limitations: This candidate preserves the completed scorer’s Boolean/null manual judgments; it does not infer or independently verify semantic quality, citation correctness or source relationships.

The exporter validates shape, frozen public-label membership, set arithmetic and the full matrix. It does not reopen finalization artifacts or verify the source-review/scoring provenance; the coordinator must first complete the committed runner finalization and score gates.

There are 40 answerable questions with two repeats per arm (80 turns per arm) and eight missing-value questions with two repeats per arm (16 turns per arm). Repeats of one question are correlated, not independent new questions. Family tags overlap.

Source-channel region sets describe reviewed coverage. An empty set does not establish that a tool or mode was unused. Mode exposure and tool-category counts require a separate audit of finalized retained source traces and are deliberately unavailable here.

Full-read recovery sets are set differences against direct-expanded, agent-search, or agent-search plus selected-read coverage. Their counts do not prove that a full read caused a correct answer or was necessary.

Unavailable usage remains null. Known subtotals are distinct from complete totals, and maximum-input metrics are aggregated as maxima, not sums. Reported retrieval charge is not a complete billed cost when retrievalChargeComplete is false or unknown.

Usage and timing are descriptive for this finite purposeful corpus and retained instrumentation. They do not establish production-scale cost, capacity, latency or enterprise-wide accuracy; cache and backend placement were uncontrolled.

Only public case/source-region/fact identifiers, fixed enums, Boolean/null judgments, finite nonnegative numeric measures and validated SHA-256 digests are emitted. Unknown fields, answers, diagnostics, wire receipts, filenames, paths, arbitrary messages, runtime IDs and deployment aliases are dropped.

A whitelist reduces accidental text/identifier disclosure but cannot detect a malicious covert encoding inside otherwise valid numeric values or public identifiers. Inputs must come from the trusted finalized scorer and frozen label pack.
